boundary_note: A-01 independently prohibits public, paid, personalized and execution-linked modes. That prohibition is separate from and additional to the rights dispositions here, and makes no other operation permitted.
fail_closed_rule: Missing, ambiguous, stale, wrong-authority, or broader-than-evidence decisions are UNKNOWN. Acquisition, transformation and use are denied except for operations a competent authority independently marks ALLOWED in a successor version.

operation_vocabulary.name: Human interactive access and reading
operation_vocabulary.scope: A person opening the document in a browser and reading it.

operation_vocabulary.name: Programmatic / automated retrieval
operation_vocabulary.scope: Any scripted, batched, scheduled, crawled, or tool-driven fetch.

operation_vocabulary.name: Retention of source bytes
operation_vocabulary.scope: Keeping the retrieved file beyond transient display, in any store.

operation_vocabulary.name: Caching
operation_vocabulary.scope: Any intermediate, proxy, or reuse cache of the source or its bytes.

operation_vocabulary.name: Source-location capture
operation_vocabulary.scope: Recording URL, document identity, page/section anchors as citations.

operation_vocabulary.name: Fact and figure extraction into internal records
operation_vocabulary.scope: Copying values, statements, or guidance text into program artifacts.

operation_vocabulary.name: Transformation and derived outputs
operation_vocabulary.scope: Computations, reconciliations, summaries, memos derived from the source.

operation_vocabulary.name: Machine processing (parser, LLM, or other automated reader)
operation_vocabulary.scope: Submitting source content to any automated processing system.

operation_vocabulary.name: Internal redistribution inside the A-01 private/internal boundary
operation_vocabulary.scope: Sharing source content or close derivatives with internal recipients.

operation_vocabulary.name: External redistribution or publication
operation_vocabulary.scope: Any distribution outside the internal boundary.

operation_vocabulary.name: Commercial use
operation_vocabulary.scope: Any revenue-linked, paid, or commercial application.

operation_vocabulary.name: Hashing / content digesting of source bytes
operation_vocabulary.scope: Computing a content digest, which requires holding the bytes.
